enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Sleep. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Sleep. Turn to right side. Push blanket. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to back. Breathe deeply. Sleep.

Wake up. Open eyes. Sit up. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wash face with water. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Take out frying pan. Place on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Pick up plate. Put eggs on plate. Open cabinet. Take out bread. Put bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Wait. Toast pops up. Take out toast. Put on plate. Open refrigerator. Take out butter. Spread butter on toast. Close refrigerator. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Wash plate. Dry plate. Put plate away.

Walk out of house. Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Insert key. Start engine. Adjust rearview mirror. Turn on radio. Drive. Stop at red light. Continue driving. Park car. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Get out. Lock car. Walk to workplace.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter workplace. Greet colleagues. Put on scrubs. Wash hands. Check patient list. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Take vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Record notes. Administer medication. Consult with doctor. Update patient chart. Walk to break room. Eat lunch. Return to work. Attend meeting. Wash hands. End shift.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Start engine. Drive. Stop at traffic light. Continue driving. Park car in driveway. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Get out. Lock car. Walk to house. Open front door. Enter house. Close door.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Take out cutting board. Place on counter. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Wash plate. Dry plate. Put plate away.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV and using computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up computer. Open laptop. Type on keyboard. Browse internet. Watch video. Put down computer. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Return to couch. Sit down. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening hygiene and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Open dresser drawer. Take out pajamas. Close drawer. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Walk to bed. Pull back blanket. Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket up. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Sleep. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Sleep. Turn to right side. Push blanket. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Breathe deeply. Remain asleep.
